mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, leading to increased economic activity, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index indicates the monetary policy stance, with a low federal funds rate and high consumer price index indicating an expansionary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low federal funds rates and high consumer price index (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the unemployment rate and payroll employment indicates the labor market conditions, with a low unemployment rate and high payroll employment indicating a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low unemployment and high payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales indicates increased consumer spending, leading to increased economic activity, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of high retail sales and monetary easing (t-test p > 0.05).
